issues.detail: The Greek 'ειδεν' (eiden) is a 3rd person singular verb, but the Vietnamese 'thấy' (thấy) lacks a subject. While often implied by context, in this specific sentence structure, it fails to clearly link back to the singular subject who 'went out' (εξελθων).

The Vietnamese translation omits the specific movement/prepositional relationship of 'περι' (peri) which indicates moving 'around' or 'about' the third hour; it simplifies this to just 'Khoảng giờ thứ ba' (About the third hour).
